en: Hetuduka, Āsavagocchaka (The Group on Taints within the Dyads on Causes)

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor associated with the taints (āsavas) … dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor associated with the taints … dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor is itself a taint (āsava) … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor is not a taint (anāsava).

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor associated with taints … dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor dissociated from taints … dependent on a state that is neither a cause, nor a taint, nor dissociated from taints …
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor an outflow,
and also not an outflow itself … Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor an outflow,
and also dissociated from outflows … Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor dissociated from outflows, and also not an outflow itself …

In dependence on a state that is not a cause, dissociated from the taints, and is not subject to taints …pe… in dependence on a state that is not a cause, dissociated from the taints, and is neither subject to taints nor not subject to taints …pe….
